fusions.name: Barge Past
fusions.desc: A shoulder barge that deals 13 damage, throws the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Cast-Off Weight
fusions.desc: Sheds your plating in a blast that deals 28 damage, ignoring armour, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Pared-Down Guard
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Moving Target
fusions.desc: Every stretch of ground you cover, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
